name: lint
title: Eolas UI Lint
description: @shadcn/lint and Eolas UI Oxlint config for Base UI design contracts.
docs: Run "npx oxlint ." to enforce Eolas UI and @shadcn/lint contracts. Ensure your `components.json` `tailwind.css` file imports `./eolas-theme.css` (or points directly to `src/eolas-theme.css`) so `shadcn/no-unknown-classes` recognizes Eolas tokens. If your UI primitives live outside src/components/ui or components/ui, add your custom directory glob to overrides[0].files in .oxlintrc.json.

files.content:
{
  "$schema": "./node_modules/oxlint/configuration_schema.json",
  "plugins": [
    "unicorn",
    "typescript",
    "oxc",
    "react",
    "jsx-a11y"
  ],
  "jsPlugins": [
    "@shadcn/lint",
    "./lint/index.mjs"
  ],
  "rules": {
    "react/rules-of-hooks": "error",
    "react/exhaustive-deps": "warn",
    "react/set-state-in-effect": "off",
    "react/refs": "off",
    "react/purity": "off",
    "react/immutability": "off",
    "jsx-a11y/aria-role": [
      "error",
      {
        "ignoreNonDOM": true
      }
    ],
    "jsx-a11y/click-events-have-key-events": "error",
    "jsx-a11y/prefer-tag-over-role": "off",
    "jsx-a11y/no-autofocus": "off",
    "jsx-a11y/no-noninteractive-tabindex": "off",
    "jsx-a11y/no-static-element-interactions": "off",
    "jsx-a11y/no-noninteractive-element-interactions": "off",
    "jsx-a11y/no-redundant-roles": "off",
    "eolas/no-positive-tabindex": "error",
    "eolas/require-iscomposing-on-enter": "error",
    "eolas/no-static-clickable-elements": "error",
    "eolas/no-raw-html-controls": "error",
    "eolas/no-radix-imports": "error",
    "eolas/no-nested-card": "error",
    "eolas/no-sparkle-icons": "error",
    "eolas/no-triple-tint": "error",
    "eolas/no-light-surface-tertiary": "error",
    "eolas/no-transition-all": "error",
    "eolas/no-spring-easing": "error",
    "eolas/no-uppercase": "error",
    "eolas/no-unsafe-type-cast": "error",
    "typescript/ban-ts-comment": "error",
    "shadcn/no-raw-colors": [
      "error",
      {
        "scanAllStrings": true
      }
    ],
    "shadcn/no-arbitrary-values": [
      "error",
      {
        "scanAllStrings": true
      }
    ],
    "shadcn/no-inline-styles": [
      "error",
      {
        "message": "Inline styles are forbidden. Use Tailwind classes with Eolas design tokens."
      }
    ],
    "shadcn/no-unknown-classes": "error",
    "shadcn/require-static-classes": "error",
    "shadcn/no-restyle": [
      "error",
      {
        "allow": [
          "layout"
        ],
        "contracts": [
          {
            "pattern": "^(Button|ButtonRoot|Button\\.Root)$",
            "allow": [
              "layout",
              "w-full",
              "mt-*",
              "mb-*",
              "mx-*",
              "my-*",
              "ms-*",
              "me-*",
              "shrink-*",
              "self-*",
              "whitespace-nowrap"
            ],
            "deny": [
              "p-*",
              "px-*",
              "py-*",
              "h-*",
              "min-h-*",
              "bg-*",
              "text-*",
              "rounded-*",
              "border-*",
              "uppercase",
              "outline-offset-0",
              "transition-all"
            ],
            "message": {
              "spacing": "Button controls its own padding and touch floors (44px min). Use size='sm'|'md'|'lg'|'icon', or apply margin/parent gap.",
              "color": "Button controls its own colors to guarantee WCAG AA contrast. Use variant='filled'|'soft'|'outline'|'text' and colorRole='primary'|'secondary'|'tertiary'|'error'|'warning'|'success'|'neutral', or use <UnstyledButton> for custom-styled bare buttons.",
              "shape": "Button enforces standard design-system border radius. Do not override rounded-*.",
              "typography": "All-caps styling (uppercase) is strictly banned on buttons per DESIGN.md.",
              "motion": "Blanket transition-all is banned. Button manages its own targeted transitions."
            }
          },
          {
            "pattern": "^(UnstyledButton|Button\\.Unstyled)$",
            "allow": [
              "layout",
              "spacing",
              "color",
              "shape",
              "typography",
              "effects",
              "motion"
            ],
            "deny": [
              "uppercase",
              "outline-offset-0",
              "transition-all"
            ],
            "message": {
              "typography": "All-caps styling (uppercase) is strictly banned on buttons per DESIGN.md.",
              "shape": "Use floating 2px focus rings (outline-offset-2), never outline-offset-0.",
              "motion": "Blanket transition-all is banned. Declare explicit targeted transition properties."
            }
          },
          {
            "pattern": "^(Icon|ToggleIcon|CrossFadeIcon|Icon\\.Toggle|Icon\\.CrossFade)$",
            "allow": [
              "layout",
              "color",
              "motion",
              "effects"
            ],
            "deny": [
              "mr-*",
              "ml-*",
              "transition-all"
            ],
            "message": {
              "default": "Use parent gap-* instead of manual margins (mr-*/ml-*) on <Icon>, and use size='xs'|'sm'|'md'|'lg'|'xl'|'inline' for sizing.",
              "layout": "Use parent gap-* instead of manual margins (mr-*/ml-*) on <Icon>, and use size='xs'|'sm'|'md'|'lg'|'xl'|'inline' for sizing.",
              "spacing": "Use parent gap-* instead of manual margins (mr-*/ml-*) on <Icon>, and use size='xs'|'sm'|'md'|'lg'|'xl'|'inline' for sizing.",
              "motion": "Blanket transition-all is banned on <Icon>. Use targeted transitions or standard animations (e.g. animate-spin)."
            }
          },
          {
            "pattern": "^(Badge|Chip)$",
            "allow": [
              "layout"
            ],
            "deny": [
              "bg-*",
              "text-*",
              "border-*",
              "rounded-*",
              "uppercase"
            ],
            "message": {
              "default": "Badge/Chip enforces high-contrast clinical status rules. Use variant='filled'|'soft'|'outline' and colorRole='primary'|'secondary'|'tertiary'|'error'|'warning'|'success'|'neutral'. Do not apply ad-hoc background/border color overrides (triple-tint anti-pattern).",
              "typography": "All-caps styling (uppercase) is strictly banned on chips/badges per DESIGN.md."
            }
          },
          {
            "pattern": "^Card$",
            "allow": [
              "layout",
              "w-*",
              "max-w-*"
            ],
            "deny": [
              "bg-*",
              "rounded-*",
              "border-*",
              "shadow-*",
              "transition-all"
            ],
            "message": "Card defines clinical elevation and containment. Use CardHeader, CardContent, and CardFooter. Never nest cards inside cards, and never use transition-all (use explicit targeted transitions)."
          },
          {
            "pattern": "^(CardHeader|CardTitle|CardDescription|CardFooter|CardAction|Card\\.Header|Card\\.Title|Card\\.Description|Card\\.Footer|Card\\.Action)$",
            "allow": [
              "layout",
              "spacing"
            ],
            "deny": [
              "uppercase",
              "bg-*",
              "border-*"
            ],
            "message": "Card subcomponents permit layout and internal spacing adjustments only. Background, border, and uppercase styling are managed by <Card>."
          },
          {
            "pattern": "^InlineAlert$",
            "allow": [
              "layout",
              "w-*"
            ],
            "deny": [
              "rounded-*"
            ],
            "message": "InlineAlert must maintain standard rectangular shape with solid 4px accent bar. Do not apply rounded-*."
          },
          {
            "pattern": "^(Toast|ToastRoot|ToastContent|Toast\\.Root|Toast\\.Content)$",
            "allow": [
              "layout",
              "w-*"
            ],
            "deny": [
              "rounded-*"
            ],
            "message": "Toast must maintain standard asymmetric shape (rounded-s-none rounded-e) with 4px start accent bar and 44x44px dismiss button. Do not apply rounded-*."
          },
          {
            "pattern": "^(Tabs|Tab|TabsList|TabsTab|TabsTrigger|Tabs\\.List|Tabs\\.Tab|Tabs\\.Trigger)$",
            "allow": [
              "layout",
              "w-*"
            ],
            "deny": [
              "bg-*",
              "uppercase"
            ],
            "message": "Tabs manage their own selection wash and active borders. Do not override backgrounds or apply uppercase styling."
          },
          {
            "pattern": "^(Input|Textarea|Select|SelectTrigger|Select\\.Trigger|Combobox|ComboboxInput|ComboboxTrigger|Combobox\\.Input|Combobox\\.Trigger|Autocomplete|AutocompleteInput|AutocompleteTrigger|Autocomplete\\.Input|Autocomplete\\.Trigger|NumberField|NumberFieldGroup|NumberFieldInput|NumberField\\.Group|NumberField\\.Input|OTPField|OTPFieldInput|OTPField\\.Input|PromptInput|PromptInputTextarea|PromptInput\\.Textarea|InputGroup|InputGroupInput|InputGroupTextarea|InputGroup\\.Input|InputGroup\\.Textarea)$",
            "allow": [
              "layout",
              "w-*"
            ],
            "deny": [
              "h-*",
              "min-h-*"
            ],
            "message": "Inputs own their touch floors (44px/48px standard). Do not override height dimensions directly."
          },
          {
            "pattern": "^(FieldGroup|FieldRoot|Field|FieldContent|Field\\.Group|Field\\.Root|Field\\.Content)$",
            "allow": [
              "layout",
              "w-*",
              "gap-*"
            ],
            "deny": [
              "uppercase"
            ],
            "message": "Field, FieldGroup, FieldRoot, and FieldContent permit layout sizing and gap spacing between fields or horizontal controls."
          },
          {
            "pattern": "^(FieldLabel|Field\\.Label)$",
            "allow": [
              "layout",
              "sr-only",
              "whitespace-nowrap"
            ],
            "deny": [
              "uppercase"
            ],
            "message": "FieldLabel owns its typography and contrast. Only layout, whitespace-nowrap, or sr-only visibility helpers are permitted."
          },
          {
            "pattern": "^(Dialog|AlertDialog|Drawer|DialogContent|DialogPopup|AlertDialogContent|AlertDialogPopup|DrawerPanel|DrawerPopup|DrawerContent|Dialog\\.Content|Dialog\\.Popup|AlertDialog\\.Content|AlertDialog\\.Popup|Drawer\\.Panel|Drawer\\.Popup|Drawer\\.Content)$",
            "allow": [
              "layout"
            ],
            "deny": [
              "bg-*",
              "rounded-*"
            ],
            "message": "Modal overlays must maintain standard surface styling, focus traps, and backdrop filters defined by Eolas UI."
          },
          {
            "pattern": "^(Popover|PopoverPopup|PopoverContent|Popover\\.Popup|Popover\\.Content|Menu|MenuPopup|MenuContent|Menu\\.Popup|Menu\\.Content|Tooltip|TooltipPopup|TooltipContent|Tooltip\\.Popup|Tooltip\\.Content|SelectPopup|SelectContent|Select\\.Popup|Select\\.Content|ComboboxPopup|ComboboxContent|Combobox\\.Popup|Combobox\\.Content|AutocompletePopup|AutocompleteContent|Autocomplete\\.Popup|Autocomplete\\.Content|ContextMenu|ContextMenuPopup|ContextMenuContent|ContextMenu\\.Popup|ContextMenu\\.Content|PreviewCard|PreviewCardPopup|PreviewCardContent|PreviewCard\\.Popup|PreviewCard\\.Content|Menubar|MenubarPopup|MenubarContent|Menubar\\.Popup|Menubar\\.Content|NavigationMenu|NavigationMenuPopup|NavigationMenuContent|NavigationMenu\\.Popup|NavigationMenu\\.Content)$",
            "allow": [
              "layout",
              "w-*",
              "max-w-*",
              "min-w-*"
            ],
            "deny": [
              "bg-*",
              "rounded-*",
              "shadow-*"
            ],
            "message": "Tier B overlay popups manage their own surface background, concentric radius, and ambient elevation per DESIGN.md."
          },
          {
            "pattern": "^(Skeleton|SkeletonReveal|Skeleton\\.Reveal)$",
            "allow": [
              "layout",
              "shape"
            ],
            "message": "Skeleton loaders support layout dimensions (w-*, h-*) and shapes (rounded, rounded-full) to mirror target components."
          },
          {
            "pattern": "^(TextSwap|NotificationBadge|TextsReveal|NumberRoll|NumberPopIn|SpinningCounter|ShimmerText|ErrorShake|SuccessCheck)$",
            "allow": [
              "layout"
            ],
            "message": "Shared motion primitives manage their own transitions and reduced-motion fallbacks per DESIGN.md."
          },
          {
            "pattern": "^(CardContent|Card\\.Content)$",
            "allow": [
              "layout",
              "spacing"
            ],
            "message": "CardContent permits internal spacing adjustments (e.g. p-0 for full-bleed media or custom padding)."
          },
          {
            "pattern": "^(TableCell|TableHead|Table\\.Cell|Table\\.Head)$",
            "allow": [
              "layout",
              "typography"
            ],
            "deny": [
              "uppercase"
            ],
            "message": "Table cells permit text alignment (text-end, text-center) and tabular numbers. All-caps styling (uppercase) is prohibited."
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  },
  "overrides": [
    {
      "files": [
        "**/components/ui/**",
        "**/src/components/ui/**",
        "**/src/ui/**"
      ],
      "rules": {
        "shadcn/no-restyle": "off",
        "shadcn/no-arbitrary-values": "off",
        "shadcn/no-inline-styles": "off",
        "shadcn/require-static-classes": "off",
        "shadcn/no-raw-colors": [
          "error",
          {
            "scanAllStrings": false
          }
        ],
        "eolas/no-raw-html-controls": "off",
        "eolas/no-static-clickable-elements": "off",
        "jsx-a11y/anchor-has-content": "off",
        "jsx-a11y/control-has-associated-label": "off",
        "jsx-a11y/label-has-associated-control": "off",
        "jsx-a11y/click-events-have-key-events": "off"
      }
    }
  ],
  "ignorePatterns": [
    "dist/**",
    "public/**",
    "node_modules/**",
    ".agents/**",
    "lint/**"
  ]
}
